methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $100M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Arc Boats is a Series B transportation company founded by Mitch Lee and Ryan Cook that has raised $100M+ to date. The transportation sector comp universe consists of seven private peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Parallel Systems, and DeepDive, with no public comparables identified.

Valuation analysis applied one applicable method due to data constraints. Stage-progression analysis, using the $100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields $190M. Peer-median methodology was not applicable; while three same-sector companies exist, insufficient narrow-stage and similar-tier filtering (requiring at least three datapoints) prevented reliable comparable company analysis. A broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given sector-specific capital intensity and growth patterns.

The triangulated valuation range is $162M (low) to $218M (high), with a median of $190M. This single-method foundation reflects meaningful uncertainty. The primary limitation is the sparse same-stage peer set within transportation; a broader dataset of adjacent-stage or similarly-capitalized transportation companies, or evidence of recent comparable transactions, would substantially increase confidence. Key variables driving value within this range include capital efficiency metrics relative to stated peers, near-term revenue trajectory, and path to profitability relative to sector norms.
